summary: Frontend testing completed for Muhasebe module bug fixes. All 3 critical issues verified as FIXED: 1) Date picker 'Şimdi' button shows correctly in all 3 tabs, 2) PDF export works with table format using jspdf-autotable, 3) Amount input scroll prevention working (onWheel blur). All features tested successfully.

issues: Turkish characters converted to ASCII (İşlem→Islem, Açıklama→Aciklama) - expected behavior for basic PDF fonts, not a bug
